All 9 tests now pass with `node --test`. I changed only the source files, not the tests.

**Bugs**
1. **`src/bill.js`, `splitBill`:** The leftover-cent check was `i <= leftover`, which gave one payer too many an extra cent. For example, 900 split 3 ways came out as `[301, 300, 300]`, so totals didn't add up. It is now `i < leftover`, so exactly `leftover` people get the extra cent.
2. **`src/duration.js`, `parseDuration`:** The code used `matchAll` to pull out any `<number><unit>` pieces and ignored the rest. So `"10m and change"` was accepted as 600 seconds. It now checks that the whole string matches `^(\d+[hms])+$` and throws `SyntaxError` otherwise. That check also covers the old "no matches" case, so I removed the `parts.length === 0` check.
